name: XDKNet 2.5.0
body:
Android TV 2.5.0, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.0 (Emby 2.0.5.0).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

This is a big one: a watchlist, personal ratings, a rebuilt library browser,
downloads on TV, a sleep timer, reworked audio passthrough, Dolby Vision
profile 7 without transcoding, and a long list of fixes. Update the server
plugin too: several of these need plugin 2.1.0.0 on Jellyfin or 2.0.5.0 on
Emby.

## New

- **My Watchlist.** Add a movie or series from its page or its card's menu,
  and find it in a My Watchlist row on Home (switch it on under Home rows) or
  from the bookmark button on Favorites. On Jellyfin it is the same list
  jellyfin-web and KefinTweaks show. On Emby it is kept by the plugin. It can
  take titles off once they're watched.
- **Personal ratings.** Rate a title with a thumb, 1 to 5 stars or a score
  out of 10 (choose under Details screen settings). My Rating shows on the
  details page and in libraries, where you can also sort and filter by it.
  Ratings are kept by the plugin and follow you to every device.
- **Library browsing.** New sorts (Last Played, Play Count, Folders First,
  Artist, Number, Date Episode Added), and filters for in progress,
  unreleased, subtitles, trailers and extras, SD/HD/4K/3D, DVD/Blu-ray/ISO,
  years, parental rating, tags and audio and subtitle language. Libraries can
  be grouped by decade, genre, rating or studio, laid out sideways, searched
  in place, and jumped through with an A-Z bar. A library's settings can be
  applied to all of them at once.
- **Downloads on Android TV**, switched on under Downloads settings, with a
  download queue, speed and time left, a check for free space first,
  "Unwatched only" for a series or season, episodes grouped by series in
  Saved Media, and a Downloads button in the navigation bar.
- **Automatic downloads.** Keep the next episodes of a series downloaded, or
  get new episodes of followed series as they arrive. Watched ones are
  removed again. Transcoded downloads now show real progress, use a codec the
  device can play, and download the version picked on the title's page.
- **Sleep timer** in the video and Live TV players: 15 to 90 minutes, the end
  of this episode or programme, or after a few episodes. It fades the sound
  before stopping.
- **Theme videos** loop quietly behind a title's page when the server has
  them. Switch them off under Local Previews.
- **Movies in several files** (part 1, part 2...) now play every part in
  turn, with the parts listed on the title's page.
- **Several addresses per server.** Give a server its home and its internet
  address, and the app uses whichever answers, switching when the network
  changes. Servers behind Cloudflare Access, Authelia or a similar proxy can
  carry custom headers. Both are under Settings > Account & Security >
  Connection.
- **Playback choices.**
  - A default playback speed, and a speed you pick holds for the rest of the
    queue.
  - "Play original quality" and "Play transcoded" in the Play button's menu
    (hold Select on Play).
  - Ordered language lists for audio and subtitles, a "Prefer text
    subtitles" switch, and your audio and subtitle choices remembered for
    each series.
  - Its own setting for each kind of skippable segment: intros, credits,
    recaps, previews and commercials.
- **Dolby Vision profile 7 plays directly.** Remuxes with Dolby Vision profile
  7 are converted to profile 8.1 as they play instead of being transcoded,
  AV1 Dolby Vision plays through its HDR10 layer, and Dolby Vision 8.1 files
  are no longer transcoded on HDR10 TVs. If a converted title looks wrong,
  Advanced options > "Always play Dolby Vision profile 7 as HDR10" goes back
  to plain HDR10.
- **Audio passthrough** is now Auto, Disabled or Manual, with a switch for
  each format. Audio your receiver can take is no longer transcoded. A
  passthrough track that goes silent, or an HDMI drop, recovers on its own. An
  app-side passthrough output helps sound bars where the TV's own path fails,
  and DTS-HD can go out as DTS for receivers that only take DTS.
- **Performance** setting under Advanced options: on low-memory TVs it uses
  less memory for artwork and holds back trailers, previews, theme music and
  theme videos.
- **Other Jellyfin apps can control this one**: play/pause, rewind, fast
  forward, going home, D-pad navigation, sending a search and the volume.
- **Search covers every server** when libraries from all of them are shown.
- **Audiobook bookmarks and notes** follow you between devices.

## Fixes

- **Playback**
  - Turning subtitles off keeps them off, on mpv and on the web player.
  - An external audio file no longer shifts the audio track numbers.
  - A subtitle mpv fails to load no longer stops playback.
  - A subtitle downloaded during playback shows at once.
  - A paused player stays paused when a track change restarts it.
  - SyncPlay: drift correction and group seeks no longer loop, a skipped
    segment is skipped once, and a backgrounded client keeps in step.
  - Casting to Chromecast lists each receiver once, respects a lower bitrate
    and no longer fails the whole cast over one track.
- **Android TV player**
  - Low-memory TVs such as the Fire TV Stick HD no longer run out of memory
    while buffering.
  - A video left in the background comes back cleanly, buffering that never
    ends recovers, and a resume no longer falls straight back into
    buffering.
  - No leftover frame under the video, and refresh-rate switching works on
    Fire TV.
  - Playback starts on the audio track you picked, and switching audio no
    longer restarts the stream.
  - A subtitle file still downloading no longer holds the picture back.
  - External PGS (.sup) subtitles show without a transcode, MKV files with
    compressed PGS subtitles open, and a crash with ASS subtitles is fixed.
- **Home and browsing**
  - Continue Watching and Next Up load more than fifteen titles.
  - Next Up no longer shows episodes already watched after a restart.
  - Watched ticks and progress update while the app is open, whichever device
    played the title.
  - Hidden libraries stay out of Rewatch and Since You Watched.
  - Recently Released fills for libraries kept in folders.
  - Classic details shows every collection a movie is in.
  - A series page shows which seasons are watched.
  - Back leaves a title's page once focus is on Play again.
- **Emby**
  - Next Up works on Emby 4.10.
  - Intro and credits markers are read however Emby sends them.
  - Genre rows and libraries hidden from My Media show again.
  - Recently Released no longer shows duplicates or ignores parental
    controls.
  - The playback info shows the HDR type.
- **Connections and sign-in**
  - An expired sign-in is checked once instead of sending a burst of failed
    requests.
  - Remote control keeps working after a server restart.
  - A connection that died unnoticed is retried.
  - Servers on international domain names connect.
  - Sign-in can't be sent twice.
  - Jellyfin 12 servers accept book pages, studio logos and car artwork.
- **Seerr:** deleted seasons and collection films can be requested again, and
  notifications keep coming while the app is open.

## Server plugin 2.1.0.0 (Emby 2.0.5.0)

- Keeps personal ratings, apart from the server's own user data, on
  Jellyfin and Emby.
- Emby gains synced bookmarks and notes, and the watchlist.
- Keeps the app's new synced settings: language lists, text subtitles,
  default speed, theme videos, skip settings and automatic downloads.

Pair with plugin 2.1.0.0 (Emby 2.0.5.0).
